s0101.literal: Recently Sadishimi on his own authority raised troops and armor, plundered Prince of Bin Chubei's baggage train, and the people were greatly alarmed and disturbed.
s0101.idiomatic: Recently Sadishimi on his own authority raised troops and armor, plundered Prince of Bin Chubei's baggage train, and the people were greatly alarmed and disturbed.

s0102.literal: Now that Sadishimi has been executed, if the city is not repaired, we fear it will embolden bandits.
s0102.idiomatic: Now that Sadishimi has been executed, if the city is not repaired, we fear it will embolden bandits.

s0103.literal: Moreover, garrison troops were withdrawn from Shazhou and Guazhou for colony farming, yielding twenty-five thousand shi of grain annually; when Sadishimi rebelled he did not permit the troops to enter the colonies, and they were abandoned.
s0103.idiomatic: Moreover, garrison troops were withdrawn from Shazhou and Guazhou for colony farming, yielding 25,000 shi of grain annually; when Sadishimi rebelled he did not permit the troops to enter the colonies, and they were abandoned.

s0104.literal: We now request that troops again be sent to colonize and plant as before, selecting one Semuren and one Han official each who know the colony lands to lead them.
s0104.idiomatic: We now request that troops again be sent to colonize and plant as before, selecting one Semuren and one Han official each who know the colony lands to lead them.

s0106.literal: On guichou day the Ministry of Revenue was established; Qitai Puji was made grand preceptor and right chancellor, Toghto left chancellor, Sanbaonu and Yeshi grand councillors, Baoba right vice chancellor, Mangqutuemur left vice chancellor, Wang Pi associate administrator; Central Secretariat Left Vice Chancellor Liu Ji was appointed left vice chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue and deliberator of Ministry of Revenue affairs; an edict was proclaimed to all under heaven.
s0106.idiomatic: On guichou day the Ministry of Revenue was established; Qitai Puji was made grand preceptor and right chancellor, Toghto left chancellor, Sanbaonu and Yeshi grand councillors, Baoba right vice chancellor, Mangqutuemur left vice chancellor, Wang Pi associate administrator; central secretariat left vice chancellor Liu Ji was appointed left vice chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue and deliberator of Ministry of Revenue affairs; an edict was proclaimed to all under heaven.

s0107.literal: On jiayin day an edict stated: because Halaqsun once joined Bayan and Aji in pacifying Jiangnan and understands military affairs, he may be appointed grand councillor and deliberator of privy council affairs.
s0107.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict stated: because Halaqsun once joined Bayan and Aji in pacifying Jiangnan and understands military affairs, he may be appointed grand councillor and deliberator of privy council affairs.

s0108.literal: Five hundred Asud guard troops were placed under Prince Qieli Buhua, stationed at Karakorum; fifteen thousand ingots of notes were granted, and each man was supplied with four horses.
s0108.idiomatic: Five hundred Asud guard troops were placed under Prince Qieli Buhua, stationed at Karakorum; 15,000 ingots of notes were granted, and each man was supplied with four horses.

s0109.literal: On jiwei day the crown prince's Right Guard Rate Office was established, rank upper third grade; Right Chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue Toghto and Censor-in-Chief Buliyadun were both ordered to head Right Guard Rate Office affairs.
s0109.idiomatic: On jiwei day the crown prince's Right Guard Rate Office was established, rank upper third grade; right chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue Toghto and censor-in-chief Buliyadun were both ordered to head Right Guard Rate Office affairs.

s0110.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "The central secretariat still has outstanding money and grain that should be pursued and settled; ten judicial officers should be retained, and the remainder all merged into the Ministry of Revenue.
s0110.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "The central secretariat still has outstanding money and grain that should be pursued and settled; ten judicial officers should be retained, and the remainder all merged into the Ministry of Revenue.

s0111.literal: " They also said: "Formerly, when capital cases were fully tried, the Ministry of Revenue deliberated and fixed them, then the central secretariat weighed and reported — the old system should be followed.
s0111.idiomatic: " They also said, "Formerly, when capital cases were fully tried, the Ministry of Revenue deliberated and fixed them, then the central secretariat weighed and reported — the old system should be followed.

s0113.literal: Hao Bin, associate administrator of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was made associate administrator of the Ministry of Revenue.
s0113.idiomatic: Hao Bin, associate administrator of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was made associate administrator of the Ministry of Revenue.

s0114.literal: On jiaxu day the name Tuerchiyan was granted to Grand Preceptor Botou.
s0114.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the name Tuerchiyan was granted to grand preceptor Botou.

s0115.literal: On dingchou day Yongping Circuit suffered frost that killed the grain.
s0115.idiomatic: On dingchou day Yongping Circuit suffered frost that killed the grain.

s0116.literal: On jimao day Sanbaonu said: "With the Ministry of Revenue established, renewing all government, changing the note system, sixty-four officials are employed; among them are imperial guard soldiers, some whose rank is not yet sufficient, some who have never held office.
s0116.idiomatic: On jimao day Sanbaonu said, "With the Ministry of Revenue established, renewing all government, changing the note system, 64 officials are employed; among them are imperial guard soldiers, some whose rank is not yet sufficient, some who have never held office.

s0117.literal: These are all habitually skilled in affairs; since they have already been appointed, we request they not be bound by precedent and be granted commission edicts.
s0117.idiomatic: These are all habitually skilled in affairs; since they have already been appointed, we request they not be bound by precedent and be granted commission edicts.

s0119.literal: An edict proclaimed to all under heaven: whoever dares obstruct Ministry of Revenue affairs shall be punished.
s0119.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed to all under heaven: whoever dares obstruct Ministry of Revenue affairs shall be punished.

s0120.literal: Zhending, Baoding, Hejian, Shunde, Guangping, Zhangde, Daming, Weihui, Huaimeng, Kaifeng, and other places suffered locusts.
s0120.idiomatic: Zhending, Baoding, Hejian, Shunde, Guangping, Zhangde, Daming, Weihui, Huaimeng, Kaifeng, and other places suffered locusts.

s0121.literal: Ninth month, gengchen new moon: by the Ministry of Revenue's comprehensive regulations an edict was sent to all under heaven; each branch central secretariat was changed to a branch Ministry of Revenue.
s0121.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengchen new moon, by the Ministry of Revenue's comprehensive regulations an edict was sent to all under heaven; each branch central secretariat was changed to a branch Ministry of Revenue.

s0122.literal: An edict stated: "Gains and losses of the court, benefits and harms to army and people — if ministers or commoners have proposals, all may submit sealed memorials to the throne; those outside submit through their superiors for forwarding.
s0122.idiomatic: An edict stated, "Gains and losses of the court, benefits and harms to army and people — if ministers or commoners have proposals, all may submit sealed memorials to the throne; those outside submit through their superiors for forwarding.

s0123.literal: People everywhere who return to their occupations after fleeing famine — all outstanding debts shall be remitted, and corvée levies waived for three years.
s0123.idiomatic: People everywhere who return to their occupations after fleeing famine — all outstanding debts shall be remitted, and corvée levies waived for three years.

s0124.literal: Where bodies lie dead in the fields and bones lie exposed, the government shall collect and bury them.
s0124.idiomatic: Where bodies lie dead in the fields and bones lie exposed, the government shall collect and bury them.

s0125.literal: " Zhidai silver notes were issued; the edict said: "In the past, after Our Taizu Emperor ascended the great throne, he first created Zhongtong paper notes for the people's convenience; years passed and the law decayed, and it was already reformed with the printing of Zhiyuan treasure notes.
s0125.idiomatic: Zhidai silver notes were issued; the edict said, "In the past, after Our Taizu Emperor ascended the great throne, he first created Zhongtong paper notes for the people's convenience; years passed and the law decayed, and it was already reformed with the printing of Zhiyuan treasure notes.

s0126.literal: Now another twenty-three years have passed; goods are heavy and notes light — flaws cannot be avoided; following the old canon, Zhidai silver notes are reformed and issued throughout the realm.
s0126.idiomatic: Now another 23 years have passed; goods are heavy and notes light — flaws cannot be avoided; following the old canon, Zhidai silver notes are reformed and issued throughout the realm.

s0127.literal: One liang of Zhidai silver notes equals five guan of Zhiyuan notes, one liang of white silver, and one qian of red gold.
s0127.idiomatic: One liang of Zhidai silver notes equals five guan of Zhiyuan notes, one liang of white silver, and one qian of red gold.

s0128.literal: Market stabilization exchange treasuries were established in every route to buy and sell gold and silver and exchange worn notes.
s0128.idiomatic: Market stabilization exchange treasuries were established in every route to buy and sell gold and silver and exchange worn notes.

s0129.literal: Or when the people bring silk, cotton, cloth, and silk to the treasury for exchange, price is given according to current estimates.
s0129.idiomatic: Or when the people bring silk, cotton, cloth, and silk to the treasury for exchange, price is given according to current estimates.

s0130.literal: In every prefecture, route, and county ever-normal granaries were set up to stabilize prices; in good years grain, wheat, rice, and millet are purchased and stored; when green and yellow do not connect, they are sold out at reduced prices compared with current estimates to check soaring prices.
s0130.idiomatic: In every prefecture, route, and county ever-normal granaries were set up to stabilize prices; in good years grain, wheat, rice, and millet are purchased and stored; when green and yellow do not connect, they are sold out at reduced prices compared with current estimates to check soaring prices.

s0131.literal: Private buying and selling of gold and silver, and shipping gold, silver, copper cash, cotton, silk, and cloth overseas by sea vessels, are all forbidden.
s0131.idiomatic: Private buying and selling of gold and silver, and shipping gold, silver, copper cash, cotton, silk, and cloth overseas by sea vessels, are all forbidden.

s0132.literal: Officials for market stabilization exchange treasuries and ever-normal granaries are all selected from regular officials, with two-year terms.
s0132.idiomatic: Officials for market stabilization exchange treasuries and ever-normal granaries are all selected from regular officials, with two-year terms.

s0133.literal: For Zhongtong exchange notes, from the day the edict arrives, within one hundred days all must be taken to the treasury for exchange.
s0133.idiomatic: For Zhongtong exchange notes, from the day the edict arrives, within 100 days all must be taken to the treasury for exchange.

s0134.literal: For tea, salt, wine, vinegar, commercial taxes, and other assorted levies, if Zhidai silver notes are collected, one counts as five.
s0134.idiomatic: For tea, salt, wine, vinegar, commercial taxes, and other assorted levies, if Zhidai silver notes are collected, one counts as five.

s0135.literal: Zhidai silver notes from two liang down to one li were issued, fixed at thirteen denominations for the people's convenience.
s0135.idiomatic: Zhidai silver notes from two liang down to one li were issued, fixed at 13 denominations for the people's convenience.

s0136.literal: " On renwu day the Jiangnan branch censorate impeached: "Grand Councillor Jiaohua falsely claimed his family was poor and improperly received grant goods worth twenty thousand ingots of notes in converted value.
s0136.idiomatic: On renwu day the Jiangnan branch censorate impeached, "Grand councillor Jiaohua falsely claimed his family was poor and improperly received grant goods worth 20,000 ingots of notes in converted value.

s0137.literal: And this man's conduct in ordinary times has not a single virtue worth naming.
s0137.idiomatic: And this man's conduct in ordinary times has not a single virtue worth naming.

s0138.literal: Duke of Wei is a noble rank of the state — how can it be granted to him?
s0138.idiomatic: Duke of Wei is a noble rank of the state — how can it be granted to him?

s0139.literal: We request seizure and recovery is appropriate.
s0139.idiomatic: We request seizure and recovery is appropriate.

s0141.literal: On guwei day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "In antiquity offices were established and duties divided, each with its charge; today the land is vast and the people numerous, affairs ever more complex — if provincial ministers grasp the overall lead and the various officials each fulfill their duties, how could affairs go ungoverned?
s0141.idiomatic: On guwei day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "In antiquity offices were established and duties divided, each with its charge; today the land is vast and the people numerous, affairs ever more complex — if provincial ministers grasp the overall lead and the various officials each fulfill their duties, how could affairs go ungoverned?

s0142.literal: In recent years provincial affairs blocked up; morning and evening only affixing and sealing documents — affairs all fell into neglect.
s0142.idiomatic: In recent years provincial affairs blocked up; morning and evening only affixing and sealing documents — affairs all fell into neglect.

s0143.literal: Heavenly disaster and the people's hardship spring from this.
s0143.idiomatic: Heavenly disaster and the people's hardship spring from this.

s0144.literal: From now on, for all Ministry and provincial affairs, all are ordered handled as circumstances permit; major matters that require memorializing may do so after receiving instruction, then act — thereby achieving utmost governance, obeying heaven's way above and settling the people's hearts below.
s0144.idiomatic: From now on, for all Ministry and provincial affairs, all are ordered handled as circumstances permit; major matters that require memorializing may do so after receiving instruction, then act — thereby achieving utmost governance, obeying heaven's way above and settling the people's hearts below.

s0145.literal: " They also said: "The state's territory is vast and its people numerous beyond what antiquity had.
s0145.idiomatic: " They also said, "The state's territory is vast and its people numerous beyond what antiquity had.

s0146.literal: Regulations of successive reigns differed front and back; enforcing officials arbitrarily weighted light and heavy — we request that from Taizu onward the nine thousand-odd administrative orders issued be culled of redundancy to unify them, compiled as fixed regulation.
s0146.idiomatic: Regulations of successive reigns differed front and back; enforcing officials arbitrarily weighted light and heavy — we request that from Taizu onward the 9,000-odd administrative orders issued be culled of redundancy to unify them, compiled as fixed regulation.

s0148.literal: Because a Buddhist temple was being built south of Dadu, a Branch Works Ministry was established with three persons directing Branch Works Ministry affairs and two branch works ministry ministers; Right Chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue Toghto was still ordered to head it concurrently.
s0148.idiomatic: Because a Buddhist temple was being built south of Dadu, a Branch Works Ministry was established with three persons directing Branch Works Ministry affairs and two branch works ministry ministers; right chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue Toghto was still ordered to head it concurrently.

s0149.literal: On bingxu day the imperial carriage reached Dadu.
s0149.idiomatic: On bingxu day the imperial carriage reached Dadu.

s0150.literal: On wuzi day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "At the Hanlin Imperial History Academy, prior reigns' imperial portraits and veritable records are all kept there — it was formerly placed at the southern secretariat.
s0150.idiomatic: On wuzi day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "At the Hanlin Imperial History Academy, prior reigns' imperial portraits and veritable records are all kept there — it was formerly placed at the southern secretariat.

s0151.literal: Now that the Ministry of Revenue is re-established, there is no time in the rush to build — we request buying a large residence and moving there.
s0151.idiomatic: Now that the Ministry of Revenue is re-established, there is no time in the rush to build — we request buying a large residence and moving there.

s0153.literal: On renchen day Prince of Gaotang Zhuan was granted five thousand liang of gold and fifty thousand liang of silver.
s0153.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince of Gaotang Zhuan was granted 5,000 liang of gold and 50,000 liang of silver.

s0154.literal: On guisi day, because firewood prices were high, powerful families and those keeping hawks and dogs were forbidden to occupy mountain grounds; the people were permitted to gather fuel.
s0154.idiomatic: On guisi day, because firewood prices were high, powerful families and those keeping hawks and dogs were forbidden to occupy mountain grounds; the people were permitted to gather fuel.

s0155.literal: Sanbaonu said: "Jining, Datong, Baoding, and Zhending, because of Wutai temple construction — all needed supplies are taken directly from the people; this year's land tax should be remitted.
s0155.idiomatic: Sanbaonu said, "Jining, Datong, Baoding, and Zhending, because of Wutai temple construction — all needed supplies are taken directly from the people; this year's land tax should be remitted.

s0157.literal: On bingshen day censorate officials said: "In recent years harvest failed and pestilence afflicted the people; Your Majesty in pity relieved them — those who were saved are many.
s0157.idiomatic: On bingshen day censorate officials said, "In recent years harvest failed and pestilence afflicted the people; Your Majesty in pity relieved them — those who were saved are many.

s0158.literal: Now Shandong suffers great famine and displaced people wander — we request the twenty thousand ingots of confiscated corrupt notes in this yamen be used for relief.
s0158.idiomatic: Now Shandong suffers great famine and displaced people wander — we request the 20,000 ingots of confiscated corrupt notes in this yamen be used for relief.

s0160.literal: On dingyou day censorate officials said: "Recently close favorites submitted petitions for others and were granted twelve hundred thirty qing of Jiangnan farmland, with rent of five hundred thousand shi — we request confiscation and return to government.
s0160.idiomatic: On dingyou day censorate officials said, "Recently close favorites submitted petitions for others and were granted 1,230 qing of Jiangnan farmland, with rent of 500,000 shi — we request confiscation and return to government.

s0162.literal: On jihai day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Present state expenses require five million ingots of Zhongtong notes; previously note capital on loan reached ten million six hundred three thousand one hundred-odd ingots; we now request abolishing Zhongtong notes, with Zhidai silver notes as mother and Zhiyuan notes as child, still allocating one million ingots of Zhiyuan note capital to supply state expenses.
s0162.idiomatic: On jihai day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Present state expenses require 5 million ingots of Zhongtong notes; previously note capital on loan reached 10,603,100-odd ingots; we now request abolishing Zhongtong notes, with Zhidai silver notes as mother and Zhiyuan notes as child, still allocating 1 million ingots of Zhiyuan note capital to supply state expenses.

s0163.literal: The Capital Resource Management Bureau was established at Dadu, rank upper second grade;
s0163.idiomatic: The Capital Resource Management Bureau was established at Dadu, rank upper second grade;

s0164.literal: six Currency Superintendencies were established in Shandong, Hedong, Liaoyang, Jianghuai, Huguang, and Chuan-Han, rank upper third grade;
s0164.idiomatic: six Currency Superintendencies were established in Shandong, Hedong, Liaoyang, Jianghuai, Huguang, and Chuan-Han, rank upper third grade;

s0165.literal: nineteen promotion commissions were established in copper-producing areas, rank lower fifth grade.
s0165.idiomatic: 19 promotion commissions were established in copper-producing areas, rank lower fifth grade.

s0166.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Inner edicts from the three palaces — formerly the central secretariat memorialized requesting they not be carried out; we consider they should still be executed as before; if they harm major affairs, then memorialize again.
s0166.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Inner edicts from the three palaces — formerly the central secretariat memorialized requesting they not be carried out; we consider they should still be executed as before; if they harm major affairs, then memorialize again.

s0168.literal: They also said: "Central secretariat affairs — we request all be fully transferred to us.
s0168.idiomatic: They also said, "Central secretariat affairs — we request all be fully transferred to us.

s0169.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan, all commission edicts were also managed by the Ministry of Revenue.
s0169.idiomatic: In the 24th year of Zhiyuan, all commission edicts were also managed by the Ministry of Revenue.

s0170.literal: Now we deliberated and request that Ministry of Revenue appoint personnel, while commission edicts and honorary ranks be entrusted to the central secretariat.
s0170.idiomatic: Now we deliberated and request that Ministry of Revenue appoint personnel, while commission edicts and honorary ranks be entrusted to the central secretariat.

s0172.literal: The king of Zhanba state sent his younger brother Zalanu and others to present tribute of white-faced elephants and kalan wood.
s0172.idiomatic: The king of Zhanba state sent his younger brother Zalanu and others to present tribute of white-faced elephants and kalan wood.

s0173.literal: Qolugh Nadish, Tughan Temür, Sanghashiri, and others memorialized requesting dispatch of envoys to overseas countries.
s0173.idiomatic: Qolugh Nadish, Tughan Temür, Sanghashiri, and others memorialized requesting dispatch of envoys to overseas countries.

s0174.literal: Tughan, Zhang Yesian, and Bayan were sent as envoys to Bolin Basun; Xuechewu, Li Tang, and Xu Bayan to Basu; Chaghan, Yibulajin, Yang Huda'er, and Ali to Zhanba.
s0174.idiomatic: Tughan, Zhang Yesian, and Bayan were sent as envoys to Bolin Basun; Xuechewu, Li Tang, and Xu Bayan to Basu; Chaghan, Yibulajin, Yang Huda'er, and Ali to Zhanba.

s0175.literal: Shadi, chief of the Shaanxi branch censorate and grand steward of the palace, was made left chancellor and pacification commissioner-commander-in-chief of the Tubo and other regions.
s0175.idiomatic: Shadi, chief of the Shaanxi branch censorate and grand steward of the palace, was made left chancellor and pacification commissioner-commander-in-chief of the Tubo and other regions.

s0176.literal: On jiachen day the Ministry of Revenue said: "Each year fodder and grain costs five hundred thousand ingots of notes — we request abolishing Bokesun and establishing an Expenditure Control Bureau, rank second grade, with commissioner, associate commissioner, vice-director, and assistant vice-director, two each.
s0176.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Ministry of Revenue said, "Each year fodder and grain costs 500,000 ingots of notes — we request abolishing Bokesun and establishing an Expenditure Control Bureau, rank second grade, with commissioner, associate commissioner, vice-director, and assistant vice-director, two each.

s0178.literal: On yisi day, because theft was prevalent, old thieves from Shangdu, Zhongdu, and Dadu were relocated to Menggud, Yiresi, and other places for farming.
s0178.idiomatic: On yisi day, because theft was prevalent, old thieves from Shangdu, Zhongdu, and Dadu were relocated to Menggud, Yiresi, and other places for farming.

s0179.literal: On dingwei day Sanbaonu said those who keep leopards harm the people greatly; an order forbade it — repeat offenders, even if noble favorites, also incur punishment.
s0179.idiomatic: On dingwei day Sanbaonu said those who keep leopards harm the people greatly; an order forbade it — repeat offenders, even if noble favorites, also incur punishment.

s0180.literal: Tenth month, winter, gengxu new moon: the crown prince was made Ministry of Revenue director and an edict proclaimed to all under heaven; regular officials of prefectures and counties were ordered to nine-year terms and an edict proclaimed to all under heaven; the copper cash system was also proclaimed to all under heaven.
s0180.idiomatic: In the tenth month, winter, on the gengxu new moon, the crown prince was made Ministry of Revenue director and an edict proclaimed to all under heaven; regular officials of prefectures and counties were ordered to nine-year terms and an edict proclaimed to all under heaven; the copper cash system was also proclaimed to all under heaven.

s0181.literal: On xinhai day the crown prince said: "Under the old system, commission edicts and honorary ranks for all officials were managed by the central secretariat — because I am central secretariat director.
s0181.idiomatic: On xinhai day the crown prince said, "Under the old system, commission edicts and honorary ranks for all officials were managed by the central secretariat — because I am central secretariat director.

s0182.literal: From now on commission documents should be issued by the Ministry of Revenue; formal commissions remain entrusted to the central secretariat.
s0182.idiomatic: From now on commission documents should be issued by the Ministry of Revenue; formal commissions remain entrusted to the central secretariat.

s0184.literal: On bingchen day Yeshi said: "Jiangnan has been pacified for nearly forty years; its people pay only land tax and commercial tax — nothing else is required of them.
s0184.idiomatic: On bingchen day Yeshi said, "Jiangnan has been pacified for nearly 40 years; its people pay only land tax and commercial tax — nothing else is required of them.

s0185.literal: Rich households that cover up and hold royal people as private slaves number in the hundreds and thousands at a stroke, some exceeding ten thousand households — their power can be imagined.
s0185.idiomatic: Rich households that cover up and hold royal people as private slaves number in the hundreds and thousands at a stroke, some exceeding 10,000 households — their power can be imagined.

s0186.literal: We request that from now on those with annual grain receipts of fifty thousand shi or more deliver two sheng per shi to the government, and still pledge one son for military service.
s0186.idiomatic: We request that from now on those with annual grain receipts of 50,000 shi or more deliver two sheng per shi to the government, and still pledge one son for military service.

s0187.literal: Of the grain they deliver, half should be moved to the capital to support the guard troops, half remain there to prepare for bad years.
s0187.idiomatic: Of the grain they deliver, half should be moved to the capital to support the guard troops, half remain there to prepare for bad years.

s0188.literal: Enriching the state and settling the people — nothing surpasses this.
s0188.idiomatic: Enriching the state and settling the people — nothing surpasses this.

s0189.literal: " The Emperor said: "Carry it out as Yeshi stated.
s0189.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Carry it out as Yeshi stated.

s0190.literal: " On xinyou day the wine prohibition was relaxed and a Wine Tax Promotion Commission was established.
s0190.idiomatic: On xinyou day the wine prohibition was relaxed and a Wine Tax Promotion Commission was established.

s0191.literal: Because money and grain affairs were complex and urgent, the Ministry of Revenue added one vice minister and one assistant director in the Revenue Ministry;
s0191.idiomatic: Because money and grain affairs were complex and urgent, the Ministry of Revenue added one vice minister and one assistant director in the Revenue Ministry;

s0192.literal: it also added one vice minister and one section director in the Rites Ministry — all who speak on current policy belong to it.
s0192.idiomatic: it also added one vice minister and one section director in the Rites Ministry — all who speak on current policy belong to it.

s0193.literal: The Imperial Temple Provisioner and Sacrificial Livestock Office was established, with one director and one assistant director each.
s0193.idiomatic: The Imperial Temple Provisioner and Sacrificial Livestock Office was established, with one director and one assistant director each.

s0194.literal: On guihai day Hanlin academician drafter Buliyadun was made censor-in-chief.
s0194.idiomatic: On guihai day Hanlin academician drafter Buliyadun was made censor-in-chief.

s0195.literal: On yichou day, because the empress dowager was ill, an edict ordered one hundred capital offenders released throughout the realm.
s0195.idiomatic: On yichou day, because the empress dowager was ill, an edict ordered 100 capital offenders released throughout the realm.

s0196.literal: On dingmao day Censor-in-Chief Jirhelang, Central Secretariat Left Chancellor Tuotuo, and Palace Apparel Bureau commissioner Dadu were all made privy council vice directors.
s0196.idiomatic: On dingmao day censor-in-chief Jirhelang, central secretariat left chancellor Tuotuo, and palace apparel bureau commissioner Dadu were all made privy council vice directors.

s0197.literal: On renshen day the moon encroached upon the Left Enforcer.
s0197.idiomatic: On renshen day the moon encroached upon the Left Enforcer.

s0198.literal: On guiyou day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Because redundant officials were recently pruned, official salaries to this day have not been paid — we request paying according to the staff numbers set in the tenth year of Dade, and paying the remainder not.
s0198.idiomatic: On guiyou day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Because redundant officials were recently pruned, official salaries to this day have not been paid — we request paying according to the staff numbers set in the tenth year of Dade, and paying the remainder not.

s0200.literal: Privy Council Vice Director Tughulu was promoted to left chancellor.
s0200.idiomatic: Privy council vice director Tughulu was promoted to left chancellor.
